:::{#cor-entropy-quantization-diverges}
#### Entropy of a quantized random variable grows without bound

In the setting of @thm-entropy-quantization,

$$\entropyf{X^\Delta} \to \infty \quad \text{as } \Delta \to 0.$$

:::

::: proof

By @thm-entropy-quantization,
$\entropyf{X^\Delta} = \entropyf{X} - \log \Delta + o(1)$.
Since $-\log \Delta \to \infty$ as $\Delta \to 0$,
and $\entropyf{X}$ does not depend on $\Delta$,
$\entropyf{X^\Delta} \to \infty$.
The limit $\infty$ differs from the [differential entropy](#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$,
so the differential entropy is not the [limit](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-limit) of the [entropy](#def-entropy) of its quantizations.

:::
